title: Initialize git repo, .gitignore, README skeleton
description: Run git init; create .gitignore (Python/venv/data/logs) and a README.md skeleton with project name and setup steps.
acceptance_criteria: git log shows at least one commit; .gitignore exists; README.md exists with project title.
notes: Git repo initialized; .gitignore and README.md created and committed.

title: Create full folder structure per Section 6
description: Create all directories from the spec: data/raw, data/processed, data/chroma_db, data/eval, logs, src/(ingestion|retrieval|generation|api|eval), frontend, notebooks, tests, scripts. Add .gitkeep files to gitignored dirs. Add __init__.py to all src packages.
acceptance_criteria: All directories exist; each src subdirectory has __init__.py; gitignored dirs have .gitkeep; data/eval/eval_set.json exists (empty).
notes: Full folder structure created with __init__.py files and .gitkeep placeholders.

title: Create PROJECT_STATE.md from template
description: Create PROJECT_STATE.md at project root using the template from Section 7.1. Fill in 'Current task: T0.3' and today's date.
acceptance_criteria: PROJECT_STATE.md exists with all sections from the template filled in.

title: Create tasks/tasks.json seeded with all tasks
description: Create tasks/tasks.json containing all tasks from Section 7.2 of the spec (all phases T0–T8). Each task has: id, phase, title, description, acceptance_criteria, depends_on, status, completed_at, notes.
acceptance_criteria: tasks/tasks.json is valid JSON; contains all tasks; T0.1–T0.3 are marked done; remaining tasks are todo.
notes: Full task list seeded with all phases T0–T8.

title: Create requirements.txt and set up virtual environment
description: Create requirements.txt with pinned versions for all dependencies (langchain, chromadb, sentence-transformers, rank-bm25, pymupdf, unstructured, fastapi, uvicorn, streamlit, ragas, anthropic, openai, ollama, python-dotenv, pytest). Create and activate a Python venv. Run pip install -r requirements.txt.
acceptance_criteria: requirements.txt exists; venv is created; pip install completes without errors; `python -c 'import langchain'` passes inside the venv.

title: Create .env.example
description: Create .env.example with keys: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, OPENAI_API_KEY, LLM_PROVIDER, USE_OLLAMA, OLLAMA_MODEL, ANTHROPIC_MODEL, OPENAI_MODEL, embedding/reranker model names, paths, and retrieval settings. Do NOT create actual .env (user must do this).
acceptance_criteria: .env.example exists with all documented keys; .env is in .gitignore.
notes: .env.example created with all required keys and defaults.

title: Build src/config.py
description: Build src/config.py that loads all env vars (from .env via pydantic-settings), exposes a singleton `settings` object with typed fields for: llm_provider, api keys, model names, paths, retrieval hyperparams. Include derived property helpers for absolute paths.
acceptance_criteria: `python src/config.py` prints the config without errors. All fields have sensible defaults so it works even without a .env file.
notes: config.py built with pydantic-settings, typed fields, derived path properties, and a singleton settings object.

title: Collect MANIT handbook + syllabus PDFs into data/raw/
description: Download or obtain the official MANIT academic handbook and course syllabus PDFs. Place them in data/raw/. Document the source URLs/dates in a data/raw/SOURCES.md file.
acceptance_criteria: At least one PDF in data/raw/; data/raw/SOURCES.md documents where it came from and the date retrieved.

title: Build ingestion/parser.py
description: Implement src/ingestion/parser.py. Use PyMuPDF (fitz) for text extraction; use unstructured for table-heavy pages. Output: a list of dicts per page with keys: text, page_number, source_doc, has_table.
acceptance_criteria: parser.parse_pdf(path) returns a list of page dicts. Running it on at least one PDF from T1.1 produces non-empty output with correct page numbers.

title: Build ingestion/chunker.py
description: Implement src/ingestion/chunker.py. Use LangChain's RecursiveCharacterTextSplitter (500–800 tokens, overlap=100). Tag each chunk with metadata: source_doc, page_number, section_heading (best-effort regex), chunk_id.
acceptance_criteria: chunker.chunk_pages(pages) returns a list of LangChain Document objects with correct metadata. Chunk sizes are within spec.

title: Build ingestion/embedder.py
description: Implement src/ingestion/embedder.py. Wrap BAAI/bge-small-en-v1.5 via sentence-transformers. Expose: embed_documents(texts), embed_query(text). Must be compatible with LangChain Embeddings interface.
acceptance_criteria: embedder.embed_query('test') returns a float list of length 384. embed_documents([...]) returns matching list of lists.

title: Build scripts/ingest.py
description: Implement scripts/ingest.py. Orchestrates: parser → chunker → embedder → write to ChromaDB. Accepts optional --source flag to process a single file. Prints progress to stdout. Idempotent: re-running doesn't duplicate chunks (use chunk_id as ChromaDB document ID).
acceptance_criteria: Running `python scripts/ingest.py` on data/raw/ PDFs populates ChromaDB without errors. Second run doesn't duplicate documents.

title: Manual QA of ingestion output
description: Inspect 5 randomly sampled chunks from ChromaDB. Check for: broken sentences at chunk boundaries, garbled table content, correct metadata (page_number, source_doc). Document findings in PROJECT_STATE.md.
acceptance_criteria: Notes in PROJECT_STATE.md confirm chunk quality is acceptable or document any issues found.

title: Build retrieval/vector_store.py
description: Implement src/retrieval/vector_store.py. Wrap ChromaDB (persistent, file-based). Expose: add_documents(docs), similarity_search(query, k), get_collection_stats(). Use the embedder from T1.4.
acceptance_criteria: vector_store.similarity_search('attendance') returns k results with correct metadata after ingestion.

title: Implement basic top-k similarity search
description: Add a basic similarity_search method to vector_store.py that returns the top-k most similar chunks with their metadata and scores. Verify it works with a test query.
acceptance_criteria: similarity_search returns results ordered by score, with metadata attached.

title: Build retrieval/hybrid_search.py
description: Implement src/retrieval/hybrid_search.py. Combine vector search (from T2.1) with BM25 (rank-bm25). Merge results using reciprocal rank fusion (RRF). Expose: hybrid_search(query, k) returning merged, deduplicated results.
acceptance_criteria: hybrid_search returns results that include both vector-close and keyword-matched chunks. RRF merging is implemented correctly.

title: Build retrieval/reranker.py
description: Implement src/retrieval/reranker.py. Use cross-encoder/ms-marco-MiniLM-L-6-v2 via sentence-transformers. Expose: rerank(query, documents, top_n) returning the top_n documents re-sorted by cross-encoder score.
acceptance_criteria: rerank('attendance', [doc1, doc2, ...], top_n=5) returns 5 documents sorted by relevance score.

title: Draft 10 sample questions and verify retrieval quality
description: Draft 10 diverse questions (easy factual, numeric, multi-hop) relevant to MANIT's handbook. Manually run each through the retrieval pipeline. Verify that correct chunks are retrieved. Save these as seed Q&A pairs in data/eval/eval_set.json.
acceptance_criteria: data/eval/eval_set.json has at least 10 entries, each with: question, expected_answer (human-written), relevant_source_page. Retrieval quality notes in PROJECT_STATE.md.

title: Build generation/llm_client.py
description: Implement src/generation/llm_client.py. Return the appropriate LangChain LLM/ChatModel based on settings.effective_llm_provider. Supports: Anthropic (ChatAnthropic), OpenAI (ChatOpenAI), Ollama (ChatOllama). Expose: get_llm() → a LangChain chat model.
acceptance_criteria: get_llm() returns a working LangChain chat model for the configured provider. A test call returns a non-empty string.

title: Build generation/prompt_templates.py
description: Implement src/generation/prompt_templates.py. Define a system prompt that: (1) instructs the LLM to answer ONLY from the provided context, (2) requires citing page/section for each claim, (3) instructs the LLM to refuse with a specific message if the answer is not in the context. Expose build_prompt(question, context_chunks) → a formatted prompt string.
acceptance_criteria: build_prompt() returns a prompt that includes the question, formatted context with citations, and the system instructions.

title: Build generation/rag_pipeline.py
description: Implement src/generation/rag_pipeline.py. Wire together: hybrid_search → reranker → prompt_templates → llm_client. Expose: run_query(question) → dict with keys: answer, sources (list of chunk metadata), latency_breakdown (dict of stage times).
acceptance_criteria: run_query('What is the attendance requirement?') returns a dict with a non-empty answer and at least one source.

title: Add citation formatting to output
description: In rag_pipeline.py and/or prompt_templates.py, ensure the final answer includes formatted citations: e.g., '[Source: Academic Handbook, Page 42, Section 4.2]'. The sources list in the response dict must include source_doc, page_number, and section_heading for each cited chunk.
acceptance_criteria: run_query() response contains clearly formatted citations in both the answer text and the sources list.

title: Add out-of-scope refusal handling
description: Test rag_pipeline.run_query() with an unrelated question (e.g., 'What is the weather today?'). The system must return the refusal message rather than hallucinating. Verify the prompt instructions in T3.2 are effective.
acceptance_criteria: An out-of-scope question returns a refusal message, not a fabricated answer. Document the test case in PROJECT_STATE.md.

title: Manual end-to-end test against 10 sample questions
description: Run all 10 questions from T2.5 through the full RAG pipeline (hybrid search + rerank + LLM). Record pass/fail and any notable issues in PROJECT_STATE.md.
acceptance_criteria: At least 8/10 questions produce an answer that matches the expected answer (from eval_set.json) and includes valid citations.

title: Expand eval_set.json to 30–50 Q&A pairs
description: Expand data/eval/eval_set.json from 10 to 30–50 Q&A pairs. Include: easy factual, numeric (e.g., credit counts), multi-hop (requiring two chunks), and out-of-scope questions (expecting refusal).
acceptance_criteria: eval_set.json has 30–50 entries with all required fields. At least 5 out-of-scope questions included.

title: Integrate ragas evaluation
description: Integrate the ragas library. Set up ragas metrics: faithfulness, context_precision, answer_relevancy. Configure ragas to use the same LLM as the main pipeline.
acceptance_criteria: ragas.evaluate() can be called on a sample of 5 Q&A pairs and returns metric scores without errors.

title: Build src/eval/run_eval.py and scripts/eval.py
description: Implement src/eval/run_eval.py: loads eval_set.json, runs each question through the pipeline, collects results. Implement scripts/eval.py: runs run_eval and prints/saves a report (JSON + human-readable summary) to logs/.
acceptance_criteria: `python scripts/eval.py` runs the full eval suite and saves a timestamped report to logs/eval_report_<timestamp>.json.

title: Run baseline eval (vector search only)
description: Temporarily disable hybrid search (vector-only) and reranker. Run scripts/eval.py. Record faithfulness, context_precision, answer_relevancy in PROJECT_STATE.md.
acceptance_criteria: Baseline metrics recorded in PROJECT_STATE.md under 'Eval results'.

title: Enable hybrid search + reranking, re-run eval
description: Re-enable hybrid search and reranking. Re-run scripts/eval.py. Record the new metrics and the delta vs. baseline in PROJECT_STATE.md.
acceptance_criteria: Updated metrics in PROJECT_STATE.md. Delta clearly shows improvement (or documents lack of improvement if that is the result).

title: Build api/main.py — FastAPI app skeleton
description: Implement src/api/main.py. Create a FastAPI app instance with title 'AskMANIT API', version, and CORS middleware (allow all origins for local dev). Include the router from routes.py. Startup event initializes the RAG pipeline.
acceptance_criteria: `uvicorn src.api.main:app` starts without errors. GET / returns a welcome JSON message.

title: Build api/schemas.py — Pydantic models
description: Implement src/api/schemas.py. Define: QueryRequest (question: str, top_k: int = 5), SourceChunk (source_doc, page_number, section_heading, content), QueryResponse (answer: str, sources: list[SourceChunk], latency_breakdown: dict), HealthResponse.
acceptance_criteria: All Pydantic models validate correctly for sample inputs. Schema appears correctly in /docs.

title: Build /query endpoint
description: Implement the POST /query endpoint in src/api/routes.py. It accepts a QueryRequest, calls rag_pipeline.run_query(), and returns a QueryResponse.
acceptance_criteria: POST /query with a valid question returns a 200 response with answer and sources. Test via /docs or curl.

title: Add streaming response support (SSE)
description: Add GET /query/stream endpoint that streams the LLM response token-by-token using Server-Sent Events (SSE). Use LangChain streaming callbacks.
acceptance_criteria: GET /query/stream returns a streaming response. Tokens appear progressively in the browser or curl output.

title: Add /health endpoint
description: Add GET /health endpoint returning: status, uptime, chromadb document count, llm_provider.
acceptance_criteria: GET /health returns 200 with all required fields.

title: Add structured local logging
description: Add structured JSON logging per query to logs/queries.jsonl. Each log entry: timestamp, question, retrieved_chunk_ids, latency_breakdown (embed_ms, retrieve_ms, rerank_ms, llm_ms, total_ms), token_counts (prompt, completion, total), answer_length.
acceptance_criteria: After running a query, logs/queries.jsonl has a new entry with all required fields.

title: Add basic error handling middleware
description: Add FastAPI exception handlers for: 422 (validation error), 500 (internal error), and a specific handler for LLM API errors (rate limit, auth failure). All errors return a consistent JSON error schema.
acceptance_criteria: Sending a malformed request returns a 422 with a readable error. Intentionally breaking the LLM call returns a 500 with a message, not a stack trace.

title: Write tests/test_api.py
description: Write pytest tests for the API using FastAPI's TestClient. Test: /health returns 200, /query returns 200 with a valid QueryResponse shape, /query with an empty question returns 422.
acceptance_criteria: `pytest tests/test_api.py` passes all tests.

title: Build frontend/streamlit_app.py — chat UI
description: Implement frontend/streamlit_app.py. A Streamlit chat interface that: maintains session-level chat history, sends questions to the FastAPI /query endpoint, displays answer and source citations.
acceptance_criteria: `streamlit run frontend/streamlit_app.py` opens a browser UI. Typing a question and pressing Enter displays an answer with sources.

title: Display citations/sources alongside each answer
description: In the Streamlit UI, display source citations in an expandable section below each answer. Show: source document name, page number, section heading, and the raw chunk text snippet.
acceptance_criteria: Each answer has a 'Sources' expander showing all retrieved chunks with metadata.

title: Add in-session chat history
description: Use st.session_state to maintain conversation history across messages. Display all prior messages (user + assistant) in the chat interface using st.chat_message.
acceptance_criteria: Sending multiple messages shows a scrollable conversation history. Refreshing the page clears history (session-only, no persistence required for v1).

title: Add thumbs up/down feedback
description: Add 👍/👎 buttons below each answer. Log the feedback to logs/feedback.jsonl (timestamp, question, answer, feedback: 'positive'|'negative').
acceptance_criteria: Clicking thumbs up/down logs an entry to logs/feedback.jsonl. UI shows a confirmation message.

title: Basic branding and styling as AskMANIT
description: Add AskMANIT branding to the Streamlit UI: custom page title, logo/icon, color theme (MANIT's navy blue/gold if possible), and a tagline. Use Streamlit theming or st.markdown with CSS.
acceptance_criteria: The UI displays 'AskMANIT' branding. Page title in browser tab reads 'AskMANIT'. Has a clear, professional look.

title: Log per-stage latency to logs/latency.jsonl
description: Ensure the RAG pipeline (T3.3) logs per-stage latency (embed_ms, retrieve_ms, rerank_ms, llm_ms, total_ms) to logs/latency.jsonl after every query. This may already be in T5.6; if so, verify and mark done.
acceptance_criteria: logs/latency.jsonl accumulates entries with all four stage timings per query.

title: Build local stats view
description: Add an extra Streamlit page (or notebook) that plots: latency trends over time (line chart by stage), feedback distribution (👍 vs 👎 pie chart), query volume over time.
acceptance_criteria: Stats page loads without error and shows charts based on data in logs/. Works even with only 5 log entries.

title: Track and display estimated token cost per query
description: In the query log and UI, display the estimated cost per query based on token counts and the provider's current pricing. Use a simple lookup table for pricing.
acceptance_criteria: Each query log entry and UI response includes an estimated_cost_usd field. Pricing table is configurable.

title: Write full README.md
description: Flesh out README.md with: problem statement, architecture diagram, setup steps (with screenshots), and example Q&A pairs.
acceptance_criteria: README.md fully describes the project, setup, and usage. A stranger can set it up by following the README alone.

title: Embed architecture diagrams into README
description: Embed the Mermaid diagrams from Section 3 of the spec into the README. Verify they render correctly on GitHub.
acceptance_criteria: README.md contains both Mermaid diagrams and they render in GitHub's Markdown preview.

title: Add eval results table to README
description: Add a 'Evaluation Results' section to README.md with the baseline and post-hybrid metrics from PROJECT_STATE.md.
acceptance_criteria: README has an eval results table comparing baseline vs. hybrid+rerank metrics.

title: Record a demo GIF/video of the chat UI
description: Record a short screen recording (GIF or video) of the chat UI in action: type a question, see it answer with citations. Embed it in README.md.
acceptance_criteria: A demo GIF or video is embedded in README.md and plays correctly.

title: (Optional) Add docker-compose.yml
description: Add a docker-compose.yml that starts the FastAPI backend and Streamlit frontend with a single `docker compose up` command.
acceptance_criteria: `docker compose up` starts both services and the UI is accessible at localhost:8501.
